conditions.notes: CLM-0023 states that number of outputs is not number of independent perspectives. The audit in OBS-0023 was designed around exactly this: instead of re-running the artifact's scripts (same transformation, correlated output), it re-derived every claim from textbook definitions via two structurally different methods. The support is methodological — the audit's value exists only to the extent its transformations differ from the artifact's. One residual correlation is declared and not removed: auditor and artifact both rely on the Lean 4.22.0 kernel, so kernel-level defects remain a shared blind spot (see LIM-0004).
